name: Chatroom 203
source:
A short chat/text based horror game about a group of friends inviting a supposed "Ghost" into a chatroom on Halloween night for fun, though they get more than what was asked for in the end.

[From [url=https://akumu-club.itch.io/chatroom-203]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款简短的聊天文字类恐怖游戏：万圣夜，一群朋友出于玩乐邀请一位自称“鬼魂”的人加入聊天室，最终却惹来了超出预期的麻烦。

[来源：[url=https://akumu-club.itch.io/chatroom-203]Itch.io[/url]]
